                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yupi/p/19406314" title="发布于 2025-12-26 18:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">什么是 RESTful API？凭什么能流行 20 多年？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2225420/202512/2225420-20251226173923485-981509675.png" alt="什么是 RESTful API？凭什么能流行 20 多年？" class="desc_img">
        你是小阿巴，刚入职的后端程序员，负责给前端的阿花提供 API 接口。结果一周后，你被阿花揍得鼻青脸肿。
阿花：你是我这辈子见过接口写的最烂的程序员！
你：接口不是能跑就行吗？
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">你是小阿巴，刚入职的后端程序员，负责给前端的阿花提供 API 接口。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718565122-87429a71-8fe0-4c54-8a2d-64659a2d13a9.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718565122-87429a71-8fe0-4c54-8a2d-64659a2d13a9.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">结果一周后，你被阿花揍得鼻青脸肿。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿花：你是我这辈子见过接口写的最烂的程序员！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718389078-bb5c6bfe-7cf8-49cf-9bb0-3a0058d4b7df.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718389078-bb5c6bfe-7cf8-49cf-9bb0-3a0058d4b7df.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你一脸委屈找到号称 “开发之狗” 的鱼皮诉苦：接口不是能跑就行吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718411442-0b73831c-e381-4bc3-bf6a-18b491b9adfb.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718411442-0b73831c-e381-4bc3-bf6a-18b491b9adfb.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮嘲笑道：小阿巴，你必须得学学 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>RESTful API</strong><span class="md-plain"> 了。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你挠挠头：阿巴阿巴，什么玩意，没听说过！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">⭐️ 推荐观看视频版，动画更生动：<span class="md-link md-pair-s"><a href="https://bilibili.com/video/BV1WFBXBmExs" rel="noopener nofollow">https://bilibili.com/video/BV1WFBXBmExs</a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">什么是 RESTful API？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：首先，REST 的全称是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>REpresentational State Transfer</strong><span class="md-plain">，翻译过来叫 “表现层状态转移”。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你一脸懵：鱼皮 gie gie，能说人话吗？我是傻子，听不太懂。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：别急，我给你拆开来讲，保证你理解。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>RE（Representational）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 表现层，是指 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>资源（Resource）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 的表现形式。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你好奇了：什么是资源？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：资源就是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>你想要操作的数据对象</strong><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如用户、商品、文章，这些都是资源。用户列表是一个资源，某个具体的用户也是一个资源。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718627611-7c551390-6002-4b4a-b06e-0bcd2b363198.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718627611-7c551390-6002-4b4a-b06e-0bcd2b363198.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">表现层是指资源呈现出来的具体格式，比如同一个用户资源，可以用 JSON 格式返回给客户端，也可以用 XML 格式返回，这就是不同的 “表现形式”。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718655176-edbb6004-5313-4f15-b4c4-c34d0ba68733.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718655176-edbb6004-5313-4f15-b4c4-c34d0ba68733.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>S（State）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 是指 “状态”。</span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：啥是状态？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：比如你登录网站后，服务器会在内存中记住 “你是谁”，之后在网站上操作就不用再次登录了，这就是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>有状态</strong><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718673710-bcde82a9-2072-4790-a633-b0f04a04fe17.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718673710-bcde82a9-2072-4790-a633-b0f04a04fe17.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>无状态（Stateless）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 呢，就是服务器不记录客户端的任何信息，每次请求都是独立的。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718694246-d34b2b7c-36e8-4d75-b0de-842806e631df.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718694246-d34b2b7c-36e8-4d75-b0de-842806e631df.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：哦哦哦，就像一个人去餐厅吃饭，服务员不记得他上次点了什么，每次都要重新点单，这就是无状态。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718730872-93531f56-4e89-480e-960e-306cfacf4d87.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718730872-93531f56-4e89-480e-960e-306cfacf4d87.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">反过来，服务员记得他爱吃鱼皮，这就是有状态。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718770523-2b6ff94d-d604-486d-a313-7592a529fe64.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718770523-2b6ff94d-d604-486d-a313-7592a529fe64.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：没错，接下来是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>T（Transfer）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 转移。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">要注意，转移是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>双向</strong><span class="md-plain"> 的：</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">1）当你用 GET 请求时，服务器把资源的状态（比如用户信息的 JSON 数据）转移给客户端。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718798187-a225681c-39d6-4298-ae77-8033c37fc5e8.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718798187-a225681c-39d6-4298-ae77-8033c37fc5e8.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">2）当你用 POST/PUT 请求时，客户端把资源的新状态（比如新用户的信息）转移给服务器，从而改变服务器上资源的状态。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718810706-2d0b3c96-2d21-43c2-be6b-3e140bc9d45d.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718810706-2d0b3c96-2d21-43c2-be6b-3e140bc9d45d.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">组合起来，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>REST（Representational State Transfer）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 是一种 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>软件架构风格</strong><span class="md-plain">，让客户端和服务器通过统一的接口，以无状态的方式，互相传递资源的表现层数据（比如 JSON），来查询或者变更资源状态。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718859239-49050273-3eb2-490c-bf12-00652a8aa03c.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718859239-49050273-3eb2-490c-bf12-00652a8aa03c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>ful</strong><span class="md-plain"> 是个后缀，就像 powerful（充满力量的）一样，表示 “充满...特性的”。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">因此，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>RESTful API 是指符合 REST 架构风格的 API</strong><span class="md-plain">，也就是遵循 REST 原则设计出来的接口。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">注意，它 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>不是协议、不是标准、不是强制规范</strong><span class="md-plain">，只是一种建议的设计风格。你可以遵循，也可以不遵循。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718902066-b7cfa9aa-ed65-4bc7-bf35-3494699b9296.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718902066-b7cfa9aa-ed65-4bc7-bf35-3494699b9296.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你挠了挠头：说了一大堆，RESTful API 到底长啥样啊？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：举个例子，比如你要做个用户管理系统，对用户信息进行增删改查，用 RESTful 风格的 API 就长这样：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>GET /users/123 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 获取 ID 为 123 的用户<br><span>POST /users &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 创建新用户<br><span>PUT /users/123 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 更新用户 123<br><span>DELETE /users/123 &nbsp; 删除用户 123</span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你眼前一亮：哇，比我写的整齐多了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718929375-35cd24d6-077e-4a5e-8cbb-7725edf8098f.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718929375-35cd24d6-077e-4a5e-8cbb-7725edf8098f.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">快带我学一下 RESTful 的写法吧，我要让前端阿花刮目相看！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718964074-a9879eb1-07bf-4117-809e-69aa33ecc2f0.jpeg"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766718964074-a9879eb1-07bf-4117-809e-69aa33ecc2f0.jpeg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">RESTful API 写法</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：好，很有志气！接下来我会带你一步步构造一个完整的 RESTful API。分为两部分，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>客户端发送请求</strong><span class="md-plain"> 和 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>服务端给出响应</strong><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">客户端请求</span></h3>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第一步：确定资源</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">资源用 URI（统一资源标识符）来表示。核心原则是：<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>用名词来表示资源，不用动词</strong><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">具体来说，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>推荐用名词复数表示资源集合</strong><span class="md-plain">，比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users</code><span class="md-plain"> 表示用户列表、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>/products</code><span class="md-plain"> 表示商品列表。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">如果要操作 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>具体某个资源，就加上 ID</strong><span class="md-plain">，比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 表示 ID 为 123 的用户。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">资源还 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>支持嵌套</strong><span class="md-plain">，比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users/123/orders</code><span class="md-plain"> 表示用户 123 的所有订单。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你想了想：那还可以更深层级么？比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users/123/orders/456</code><span class="md-plain"> 表示用户 123 的订单 456。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719127316-ef85c880-d735-4c07-a6ae-99c8a90bd565.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719127316-ef85c880-d735-4c07-a6ae-99c8a90bd565.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮点点头：你的理解完全正确，但不建议嵌套层级太深。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第二步：选择动作</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">确定了资源后，接下来要选择 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>动作</strong><span class="md-plain">，也就是你想怎么处理这个资源。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">RESTful API 主要通过不同的 HTTP 方法来表示增删改查操作：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">1）GET：查询资源</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /users</code><span class="md-plain"> 查询所有用户</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 查询 ID 为 123 的用户</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">2）POST：创建资源</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /users</code><span class="md-plain"> 创建新用户</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">3）PUT：完整更新资源，需要提供资源的所有字段，多次执行结果相同（幂等性）</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>PUT /users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 完整更新用户 123</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">4）PATCH：部分更新资源，通常用于更精细的操作</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>PATCH /users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 只更新用户 123 的某些字段</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">5）DELETE：删除资源</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>DELETE /users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 删除用户 123</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719179661-0a9b3f35-07b3-4f6b-8d90-37290dd9a53c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719179661-0a9b3f35-07b3-4f6b-8d90-37290dd9a53c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：到这里，一个基本的 RESTful API 请求就构造完成了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：就这么简单？我不满足，还有更高级的写法吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：当然~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第三步：添加查询条件（可选）</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">有时候我们需要更精确地筛选数据，这时候可以加查询参数，比如：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">分页：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users?page=2&amp;limit=10</code><span class="md-plain"> 查询第 2 页，每页 10 条用户数据</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">过滤：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users?gender=male&amp;age=25</code><span class="md-plain"> 查询性别为男、年龄 25 的用户</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">排序：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users?sort=created_at&amp;order=desc</code><span class="md-plain"> 按创建时间倒序排列用户</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：等等，这查询参数跟 RESTful 有啥关系？正常的请求不都是这么写吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：确实，查询参数本身不是 RESTful 特有的。但 RESTful 风格强调 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>把筛选、排序、分页这些操作，都通过 URL 参数来表达</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719276157-ae1af5d0-0fca-4d3b-837f-c0a00312c35a.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719276157-ae1af5d0-0fca-4d3b-837f-c0a00312c35a.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而不是在请求体里传一堆复杂的 JSON 对象：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719305263-a6cc4518-afa7-4e59-b3df-e13b5a23a5e7.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719305263-a6cc4518-afa7-4e59-b3df-e13b5a23a5e7.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样一来，URL 更清晰，而且浏览器、CDN、代理服务器都能直接根据 URL 来缓存响应结果。比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users?page=1</code><span class="md-plain"> 和 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users?page=2</code><span class="md-plain"> 是两个不同的 URL，可以分别缓存。但如果把参数放在请求体里，URL 都是 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/users</code><span class="md-plain">，缓存就没法区分了。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719343468-de92435c-f3e0-4cc6-8eb8-cfca50ee4872.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719343468-de92435c-f3e0-4cc6-8eb8-cfca50ee4872.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第四步：版本控制（可选）</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">随着业务发展，接口可能需要升级。为了不影响老用户，可以在 URI 中标明版本：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/v1/users</code><span class="md-plain"> 第一版用户接口</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/v2/users</code><span class="md-plain"> 第二版用户接口</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样，老用户继续用 v1，新用户用 v2，互不影响。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719366256-f8856259-6852-4f91-a096-ed8f592ac3f2.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719366256-f8856259-6852-4f91-a096-ed8f592ac3f2.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">第五步：保持无状态</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">此外，还记得我们前面讲 REST 里的 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>ST（State Transfer）</strong><span class="md-plain"> 吗？</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">RESTful 的核心原则之一是 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>无状态（Stateless）</strong><span class="md-plain">，客户端每次请求必须包含所有必要信息，服务器不记录客户端状态。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如用户登录后，不是让服务器记住 “你已经登录了”，而是每次请求都要带上身份凭证（Token），像这样：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>GET /orders<br><span>Header: Authorization: Bearer xxx</span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这么做的好处是，服务器不用记录谁登录了、谁没登录，每个请求都是独立的。这样一来，你想加多少台服务器都行，任何一台都能处理请求，轻松实现负载均衡和横向扩展。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719401594-e3d07b7a-5c8d-45f5-b4f6-6071ae9f00f1.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719401594-e3d07b7a-5c8d-45f5-b4f6-6071ae9f00f1.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你点头如捣蒜：怪不得我调用 AI 大模型 API 的时候，就要传这个 Token！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">服务端响应</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：讲完客户端请求，再来看服务器收到请求后，该怎么响应？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">主要注意 2 点：</span></p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1、统一响应格式</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">目前大多数 RESTful API 基本都用 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>JSON</strong><span class="md-plain"> 格式，因为轻量、容易解析。</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>{<br><span>&nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"id":&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">123,<br><span>&nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"name":&nbsp;<span class="cm-string">"小阿巴",<br><span>&nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"email":&nbsp;<span class="cm-string">"aba@codefather.cn"<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">但这并不是强制的，也可以用 XML、HTML 等格式。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719464119-5b86fd15-076d-4e7f-b945-13cc1ca86630.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719464119-5b86fd15-076d-4e7f-b945-13cc1ca86630.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2、返回合适的 HTTP 状态码</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">响应要带上合适的状态码，让客户端一眼看懂发生了什么。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719507042-eba5456a-00fe-40b6-ac80-1892008932df.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719507042-eba5456a-00fe-40b6-ac80-1892008932df.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">HTTP 状态码有很多，大体可以分为 5 类：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>1xx 系列</strong><span class="md-plain">：信息提示（用得少，了解即可）</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>2xx 系列</strong><span class="md-plain">：成功</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">200 OK：请求成功，正常返回数据（用于 GET、PUT、PATCH）</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>3xx 系列</strong><span class="md-plain">：重定向</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">301 Moved Permanently：资源永久移动到新位置</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">302 Found：资源临时移动</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>4xx 系列</strong><span class="md-plain">：客户端错误</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">400 Bad Request：请求参数格式错误</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">401 Unauthorized：未验证身份，需要登录</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">403 Forbidden：已认证但没有权限访问</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">404 Not Found：资源不存在</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">405 Method Not Allowed：请求方法不被允许</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>5xx 系列</strong><span class="md-plain">：服务器错误</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">500 Internal Server Error：服务器内部错误</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">502 Bad Gateway：网关错误</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">503 Service Unavailable：服务暂时不可用</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">504 Gateway Timeout：网关超时</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719536008-35950567-47ee-45a7-aa54-1b4fc19e17ab.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719536008-35950567-47ee-45a7-aa54-1b4fc19e17ab.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你恍然大悟：懂了，以后前端看到 500，就知道是我后端的锅；看到 400，就知道是她自己传参传错了。谁也别想甩锅！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719551433-f156ab73-a69c-4bf6-8fac-6c4379669dd5.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719551433-f156ab73-a69c-4bf6-8fac-6c4379669dd5.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮点点头：不错，以上这些，就是 RESTful API 的基本写法。你学会了吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：学废了，学废了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719705610-d26d7fe2-21c7-4e62-8e71-5cfae3ca7cf8.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719705610-d26d7fe2-21c7-4e62-8e71-5cfae3ca7cf8.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：那我来考考你，下面哪个是标准的 RESTful API？</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">A. <span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /getUsers</code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">B. <span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /user/list</code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">C. <span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /users/query</code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">D. <span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /users/delete/123</code></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你开心地怪叫起来：阿巴，肯定是 C 啊！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719753758-bf0ed259-a268-4a01-a053-46df69b68363.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719753758-bf0ed259-a268-4a01-a053-46df69b68363.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：错，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>4 个全都不标准</strong><span class="md-plain">！</span></span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">A 用了动词 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>getUsers</code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">B 用了单数 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>user</code><span class="md-plain"> 和动词 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>list</code></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">C 用 POST 查询，还带了动词 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>query</code></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">D 用 GET 删除，还带了动词 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>delete</code></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你掉了根头发：原来这么严格！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719780955-535f4883-fc46-433d-975e-f60c34471b0c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719780955-535f4883-fc46-433d-975e-f60c34471b0c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">等等，你说 RESTful 不能用动词，但有些操作不是标准的增删改查啊，比如用户要支付订单，该怎么设计接口呢？是要用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /orders/123/pay</code><span class="md-plain">？</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇头：你已经很努力了，但 pay 是动词。更标准的设计是把 “支付” 行为看作 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>创建</strong><span class="md-plain"> 一个支付记录，用名词而不是动词。</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>POST /orders/123/payments</span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如这个请求，表示为订单 123 创建一笔支付记录。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你又掉了根头发：妙啊，怪不得说英语对学编程有帮助呢，我悟了，我悟了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719872557-cbfef19a-b5ce-4e95-9665-b2b6cf18fa64.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719872557-cbfef19a-b5ce-4e95-9665-b2b6cf18fa64.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">RESTful 的六大约束</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：不错，学到这里你已经掌握了 RESTful 的 80%，能够实际应用了。接下来的知识，你只需简单了解一下，就能拿去和面试官吹牛皮了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如很多同学都不知道，RESTful 其实有 6 个约束条件：</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Client-Server（客户端-服务器分离）：前后端各干各的活，前端负责展示，后端负责数据处理，互不干扰。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Stateless（无状态）：每次请求都是独立的，服务器不保存客户端的会话信息，所有必要信息都在请求中携带。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Cacheable（可缓存）：服务器的响应可以被标记为可缓存或不可缓存，客户端可以重用缓存数据，减少服务器压力，提升性能。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Layered System（分层系统）：客户端不需要知道直接连的是服务器还是中间层，系统可以灵活地加代理、网关、负载均衡器等。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Uniform Interface（统一接口）：所有资源都通过统一的接口访问，降低理解成本，提高可维护性。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Code-On-Demand（按需代码）：可选项，服务器可以返回可执行代码（比如 JavaScript）给客户端执行，但实际工作中很少用。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719889071-52203b09-409a-4f22-a15b-fb76f3df98c4.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719889071-52203b09-409a-4f22-a15b-fb76f3df98c4.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你直接听懵了：阿巴阿巴，这么多约束，我必须全遵守吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：可以不用，RESTful 只是一种 API 的 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>建议风格</strong><span class="md-plain">。在实际工作中，很少有 API 能完美符合所有约束，大家可以灵活调整，甚至什么接口都用 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>POST + 动词</strong><span class="md-plain"> 一把梭。只要团队达成一致、用得舒服就行。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719911576-7c8575aa-9ed5-47f8-a9e6-245d68ab25cb.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719911576-7c8575aa-9ed5-47f8-a9e6-245d68ab25cb.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">就像刚才那个支付订单的例子，<span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /orders/123/payments</code><span class="md-plain"> 虽然符合 RESTful 规范，但有同学会觉得 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /orders/123/pay</code><span class="md-plain"> 更直观易懂，也没问题。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">不过现阶段，我建议你先养成遵循 RESTful 的好习惯，等积累了经验，再根据实际情况灵活调整。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">怎么快速实现 RESTful API？</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：呜呜，但我只是个小阿巴，背不下来这些写法，我怕自己写着写着就不规范了，怎么办啊？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719943517-67dcad60-c106-4726-a08a-83d0c1d01d6b.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719943517-67dcad60-c106-4726-a08a-83d0c1d01d6b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：别担心，有很多方法可以帮你快速实现和检查 RESTful API。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1、使用开发框架</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">几乎所有主流开发框架都支持 RESTful API 的开发，它们能帮你自动处理很多细节，比如：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Java 的 Spring Boot：通过 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>@GetMapping("/users")</code><span class="md-plain">、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>@PostMapping("/users")</code><span class="md-plain"> 等注解，你只需要写一行代码就能定义符合 RESTful 风格的路由。框架会自动把对象转成 JSON、设置正确的 HTTP 状态码，你都不用操心。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Python 的 Django REST Framework：你只需要定义一个数据模型（比如 User 类），框架就能自动生成 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /users</code><span class="md-plain">、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>POST /users</code><span class="md-plain">、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>PUT /users/123</code><span class="md-plain">、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>DELETE /users/123</code><span class="md-plain"> 这一整套 RESTful 接口，大幅减少代码量。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">Go 的 Gin ：专门为 RESTful API 设计，语法非常简洁。比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>router.GET("/users/:id", getUser)</code><span class="md-plain"> 就能绑定一个 GET 请求，自动从 URL 中提取 ID 参数，还能通过路由分组把 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/v1/users</code><span class="md-plain"> 和 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/v2/users</code><span class="md-plain"> 轻松分开管理。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这些框架虽然不强制你遵循 RESTful，但用它们的特性，开发起来既轻松又规范，帮你省掉大量重复代码。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719959508-78fd2f42-5f29-40c5-bf26-b6200f98360b.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766719959508-78fd2f42-5f29-40c5-bf26-b6200f98360b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2、使用 IDE 插件</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如 IDEA 的 RESTful Toolkit 插件，可以快速查看和测试接口。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765877959888-729c1b21-3a79-43d2-89d0-3dc7bc673332.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765877959888-729c1b21-3a79-43d2-89d0-3dc7bc673332.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">还有 VSCode 的 REST Client 插件，可以直接在编辑器里测试接口。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765878023937-b4044429-0af1-44ce-b2a1-31ec47f6c60b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1765878023937-b4044429-0af1-44ce-b2a1-31ec47f6c60b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3、利用 AI 生成</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">RESTful 有明确的设计规范，而 AI 最擅长处理这种有章可循的东西！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">比如直接让 Cursor 帮你用 Spring Boot 写一个用户管理的 RESTful API：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720037933-3ee18c61-2389-4918-a475-811a75190d9a.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720037933-3ee18c61-2389-4918-a475-811a75190d9a.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你只需要阿巴阿巴几下，它就能生成规范的代码。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720058329-918c7038-29ac-4606-9528-93b4890d9165.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720058329-918c7038-29ac-4606-9528-93b4890d9165.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">4、生成接口文档</span></h4>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">写完接口后，还可以用 Swagger 这类工具自动生成漂亮的接口文档，直接甩给前端，对方一看就懂，还能在线测试接口，省去大量沟通成本。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720097925-ff07763f-bf90-4ec7-b90f-a9c412b00463.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720097925-ff07763f-bf90-4ec7-b90f-a9c412b00463.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你笑得像个孩子：这么一看，RESTful API 不仅让接口规范统一，还能提高开发效率，降低团队沟通成本，前后端都舒服！爽爽爽！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720154305-28719872-c659-4d06-a2b9-600bebf5683e.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720154305-28719872-c659-4d06-a2b9-600bebf5683e.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮点点头：没错，这也是为什么 RESTful 能成为业界主流的原因。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：学会了学会了，我这就去重构所有接口，让前端阿花刮目相看！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720229286-46586d9f-85ed-42a3-a658-1f7b60bfbf4e.jpeg"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720229286-46586d9f-85ed-42a3-a658-1f7b60bfbf4e.jpeg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">结尾</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">一周后，你把所有接口重构成了 RESTful 风格。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">前端阿花打开新的接口文档，眼睛亮了：小阿巴，你居然开窍了？！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720278230-0c81bf84-5e09-4a84-b668-67b33439f2dd.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720278230-0c81bf84-5e09-4a84-b668-67b33439f2dd.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你得意地笑了：那是，我可是学过 RESTful 的男人~ 阿花，晚上要不要一起？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720295691-b3a3ad3c-7244-4013-8d70-9bc3a91027f5.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720295691-b3a3ad3c-7244-4013-8d70-9bc3a91027f5.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿花朝你吐了口唾沫：呸，你只不过学了一种 API 风格就得意洋洋。阿坤哥哥不仅精通 RESTful，还能手撕 GraphQL 和 gRPC 呢，你行么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720320590-9398c01e-a021-4dc0-85ad-a665a45525c4.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720320590-9398c01e-a021-4dc0-85ad-a665a45525c4.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你难受得不行：啥啥啥，这都是啥啊…… 鱼皮 gie gie 快来救我！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720349238-c70ad907-410e-4b55-a491-9374ee5c34ac.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1766720349238-c70ad907-410e-4b55-a491-9374ee5c34ac.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
